data.title: EVA Air Wins Three No. 1 SKYTRAX Awards and 11th Consecutive 5-Star Rating
data.description: TAIPEI, TAIWAN – EVA Air once again earned top honours at the prestigious SKYTRAX World Airline Awards, taking first place in three categories: World’s Best Premium Economy Class, World’s Best Premium Economy Class Airline Amenities, and World’s Most Family Friendly Airline at the prestigious SKYTRAX World Airline Awards. The carrier also retained its coveted SKYTRAX 5-Star Airline rating for the 11th consecutive year, reaffirming its longstanding commitment to excellence in safety and service.

data.title: TOA Launches ‘TOA Wood Expert’ Campaign to Promote Sustainable Wood Care
data.description: As a comprehensive wood-care expert and a leader in eco-friendly paint innovations and construction materials in Thailand, TOA Paint (Thailand) is building on this philosophy with its major annual campaign, “TOA Wood Expert: Caring for Wood Together.” Under the concept “Caring for the Wood at Home Means Caring for the Wood in the Forest,” the campaign encourages Thais to look beyond simply extending the lifespan of wooden products and to embrace more responsible resource consumption and greater environmental awareness.

data.title: Thai Union CEO Thiraphong Chansiri wins Global Seafood Alliance lifetime achievement award
data.description: BANGKOK, September 22, 2026 – Thiraphong Chansiri, President & CEO of Thai Union Group PCL, received the Wallace R. Stevens Lifetime Achievement Award from the Global Seafood Alliance (GSA), recognizing more than three decades of leadership that helped transform Thai Union and change the seafood industry.

data.title: Huawei, SVOA and ACONNECT Join Forces to Advance AI-Powered Customer Service
data.description: Bangkok, 21 September 2026 – Huawei, SVOA Public Company Limited (SVOA), and “Aconnect Contact Center”, a business of Advanced Research Group (ARG) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Artificial Intelligence Contact Center (AICC) solutions, marking a new step in their collaboration to develop AI-powered customer service solutions for organisations in Thailand. The collaboration aims to enhance Contact Center efficiency and elevate customer experience, with an initial focus on banking, insurance, retail, and large enterprises.

data.title: Bangkok Launches New Effort to Address Health Impacts of Extreme Heat
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) today announced the city will begin development of its Integrated and Evidence-Based Heat–Health Action Plan as part of Bangkok’s work with the Partnership for Healthy Cities—a global network of more than 70 cities committed to saving lives by preventing noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) and injuries. The initiative, launched in collaboration with the Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), will use scientific evidence to identify the neighborhoods where heat poses the greatest health risks, who is most vulnerable, and what measures can better protect residents.

data.title: Wonder AI accelerates smart retail expansion as AI reshapes business landscape
data.description: Wonder AI Co Ltd is speeding up its market expansion as brick-and-mortar operators increasingly turn to artificial intelligence (AI) to boost operational efficiency and capture deeper shopper insights amid shifting consumer habits and mounting overheads.

data.title: Vacheron Constantin and The Met to unveil three artisan artworks in New York
data.description: Vacheron Constantin (@vacheronconstantin) and The MET in New York, is set to unveil three artworks from the Artisan Residency Program on October 8, 2026. A mentorship programme and creativity through an exchange of knowledge and expertise between artisans at Vacheron Constantin’s watchmaking manufacture in Switzerland and The MET in New York over an 18-month period. The three artworks were created by the selected artisans participating in the program.

data.title: Grand Opening of the 2026 Zhejiang International Trade Exhibition (Thai)
data.description: On September 16th, 2026, the "2026 Zhejiang International Trade Exhibition (Thai)" hosted by the Zhejiang Provincial Department of Commerce was officially kicked off at the prestigious IMPACT Exhibition Center in Bangkok, Thailand. At the official opening ceremony, guests of honour Varawut Silpa-archa, Minister of Industry, Aditad Vasinonta, Director General Department of Primary Industries and Mines, Loy Joon How, General Manager, IMPACT Exhibition Management Co., Ltd., presided to witness this grand and momentous occasion and partook in a special VIP tour of the exhibition, setting the stage for what promises to be a landmark event in international trade. The guests of honour highly complimented products of Zhejiang province, particularly renowned homegrown brands and fully affirmed the exceptional brand image of "quality Zhejiang goods".

data.title: LH Bank Partners with Thailand Privilege Card to Offer Exclusive Benefits for Expats
data.description: Mr. Hsieh, Yu-Hung, Executive Vice President -Retail Strategy and Performance Management of Land and Houses Bank Public Company Limited or LH Bank, stated that the bank has continuously developed its products and enhanced its services to meet the diverse needs of customers. With the strong support of CTBC Bank , Taiwan’s leading private bank and LH Bank’s parent company, as well as its extensive international financial networks, LH Bank is well positioned to provide comprehensive financial services and supports for foreign customers, particularly Mandarin-speaking customers, who represent a main segment who resides, invests, and runs business in Thailand. LH Bank recognizes that customers in this segment may not have sufficient access to comprehensive financial services that fully address their needs. Therefore, LH Bank is committed to expanding its services to specifically serve this segment, while continuously developing its financial products and services to better align with their needs. The partnership with Thailand Privilege Card Company Limited, a service provider of long-term resident visa, to offer convenient, comprehensive financial and investment privileges and experiences for expats residing in Thailand, a growing segment with a vital role in the country's economy and investment.

data.title: Trading Without Installation: Why Web Terminals Matter for Active Traders
data.description: For an active trader, instant market access is now considered a necessity rather than an option. Sometimes market opportunities do not present themselves when a trader is at the same desk, device, or trading software. This is why web-based trading systems are getting more common.

data.title: How Browser-Based Trading Is Changing Access to Global CFD Markets
data.description: Access to the world market has been revolutionised within the last ten years. Traders who used to rely heavily on desktop software installed on their computers can now carry out their operations in a web browser. This development is making the trading of Contracts for Difference (CFD) much more convenient and flexible.

data.title: The Rise of Flexible CFD Trading Platforms
data.description: Ten years ago, retail trading was largely centred around installed desktop terminals. That model is waning. Finance Magnates Intelligence estimated mobile as responsible for 64.6% of retail trading transactions in 2025. According to FCA's Financial Lives 2024 survey , there were 1.6 million UK adults who used a trading app, 47% of whom fell in the age group 18-34. Where you trade from has become a product feature.

data.title: Makro and Heliconia bring “Udon Love Like a PRO” to Udon Thani
data.description: Udon Thani – September 17, 2569 (2026): Makro, the leading wholesale business under CP Axtra Public Company Limited, has joined with leading business partner Heliconia H Group Company Limited and local entrepreneurs to launch the "Makro x Heliconia Udon Love Like a PRO" event, celebrating Makro's 37th anniversary. The four-day food, shopping and music festival at Muang Thong Charoensri Market features a landmark 30 meter waterfall, about the height of a 10-storey building, along with more than 50 celebrity chefs, popular restaurant menus, exceptional shopping deals and concerts by leading artists. Designed to boost the local economy and bring joy to the people of Udon Thani and visiting tourists, the event was honoured by Mr. Nattapong Khamwongpin, Deputy Governor of Udon Thani Province, who presided over the opening ceremony. Mr. Tanit Chearavanont, Group CEO Wholesale Business of CP AXTRA, Mr. Kitikorn Penrote, Chief Executive Officer of Heliconia H Group, and business partners welcomed guests.

data.title: “KANEKO HANNOSUKE” Pins New Location at “Central Northville”
data.description: Adds More Than 10 New Menu Items KANEKO HANNOSUKE” ( คาเนโกะฮันโนะสึเกะ), a premium tempura rice bowl restaurant from Tokyo, Japan, continues its expansion in Thailand following a positive response from Thai customers. Most recently, the brand opened its 4th branch on the G floor of Central Northville, marking its first branch in a Central shoppingcentre. The opening also introduces a refreshed logo, along with more than 10 newmenu items, to offer greater variety and cater to the needs of a broader range of customers in the area.

data.title: Building organisations that transform faster than technology changes
data.description: Only a few years ago, the breakthrough in generative artificial intelligence (AI) allowed us for the first time to ask a machine a question and receive a remarkably human-like answer. OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra and Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.1 represent the latest frontiers in what machines can now do across coding, computer use and scientific work. But the real problem for business leaders is the speed at which the boundary of what machines can do keeps moving.
